question: Is there an approved AI policy covering acceptable and prohibited use?
Is a named owner accountable for each AI system?
Is there an inventory of all AI systems, models and third-party AI services in use?
Is each AI use case assessed for impact on people and the business before approval?
Is personal and confidential data classified before it is used with AI?
Are staff trained on safe and approved AI use?
Are AI vendors assessed for data use, retention and training on customer data?
Is there an approved-tools list and a way to detect unapproved AI use?
Are AI systems tested for prompt injection and jailbreaks before release?
Are model outputs validated before downstream systems act on them?
Are agent permissions least-privilege with human approval for high-impact actions?
Are prompts, outputs and tool calls logged well enough for audit and investigation?
Are training and retrieval data sources vetted and protected against poisoning?
Are system prompts and embedded secrets protected from disclosure?
Are usage limits and cost controls in place to prevent abuse?
Are accuracy, bias and misinformation risks tested and monitored?
Is there an AI incident response procedure?
Are users told when they interact with AI and are limitations documented?
Are legal and regulatory requirements identified for each AI use case?
Are models and AI components versioned with change control and rollback?
